categories.name: Flat & graphic
categories.note: Bold shapes and color, little or no depth

categories.name: Retro & digital
categories.note: Old screens, tapes, prints and frame rates

categories.name: Type, UI & data
categories.note: Words, interfaces and numbers in motion

styles.name: Flat 2D
styles.desc: Solid colors and simple shapes with no shadows, gradients or texture. Clean and easy to read, so it's the go-to for explainer videos.
styles.prompt: flat 2D vector animation, solid colors, no gradients or shadows

styles.name: Swiss minimal
styles.desc: A strict column grid, big bold numbers, lots of white space and one strong accent color. Motion snaps from column to column.
styles.prompt: Swiss minimal motion design, strict grid, bold sans-serif numbers, single red accent, snappy easing
styles.html: 24

styles.name: Bauhaus geometric
styles.desc: Primary colors and basic shapes (circles, half circles, bars) moving in a tidy composition.
styles.prompt: Bauhaus geometric motion, red, yellow, blue and black shapes on off-white

styles.name: Memphis
styles.desc: Playful geometric shapes, squiggles, zigzags and dot patterns in loud colors, scattered like confetti.
styles.prompt: Memphis design style, squiggles, zigzags, striped circles and triangles, bold 80s colors, floating motion

styles.name: Neo-brutalism
styles.desc: Bright flat colors, thick black borders and hard offset shadows with no blur. Buttons press into their shadows.
styles.prompt: neo-brutalist style, bold flat colors, thick black outlines, hard offset drop shadows, chunky type
styles.html:
Hello!
NEWCLICK

styles.name: Pop art comic
styles.desc: Bold comic-book look with printed dot patterns, starburst shapes and punchy sound-effect words.
styles.prompt: pop art comic style, Ben-Day dots, starburst with POW text, bold outlines, punchy zoom
styles.html: POW!

styles.name: Paper cutout
styles.desc: Flat layers that look cut from paper, separated by soft shadows so they read as stacked on top of each other.
styles.prompt: layered paper cutout style with soft drop shadows, gentle parallax

styles.name: Collage
styles.desc: Torn paper, newspaper scraps, halftone photos and tape layered together, with a slight stop-motion jitter.
styles.prompt: mixed media collage animation, torn paper, newspaper scraps, halftone cutouts, tape, stop-motion jitter
styles.html: CUT!

styles.name: Isometric
styles.desc: 3D objects drawn at a fixed angle with no perspective, so parallel lines never meet. Common for tech, maps and diagrams.
styles.prompt: isometric 3D illustration style, floating cubes, soft pastel colors

styles.name: Clay 3D
styles.desc: Rounded, inflated shapes with soft inner shadows. Works well with squash and stretch, where things flatten and bounce.
styles.prompt: soft clay 3D style, puffy pastel shapes, squash and stretch bounce

styles.name: Glossy 3D
styles.desc: Smooth, shiny objects with soft studio lighting, bright highlights and reflections on the floor.
styles.prompt: glossy 3D render, shiny plastic shapes, soft studio lighting, reflective floor

styles.name: Low poly
styles.desc: Scenes built from visible flat triangles, each with its own shade, so surfaces look cut like a gem.
styles.prompt: low poly landscape, flat-shaded triangles, sunset palette

styles.name: Wireframe hologram
styles.desc: Glowing outlines with see-through faces over a scrolling grid. Reads as futuristic or technical.
styles.prompt: holographic wireframe cube, glowing cyan lines, scanlines, grid floor, sci-fi HUD

styles.name: Cel-shaded / anime
styles.aka: Toon shading, speed lines, impact frame
styles.desc: Hard-edged light and shadow with no soft blending, often with radiating speed lines behind a moment of impact.
styles.prompt: cel-shaded anime style, hard shadows, radial speed lines, impact frame

styles.name: Glassmorphism
styles.desc: See-through panels that blur whatever moves behind them, with a thin bright edge. Feels modern and app-like.
styles.prompt: glassmorphism, frosted glass card over moving colorful blobs

styles.name: Neon glow
styles.desc: Bright glowing lines and lettering on a dark background, often with a slight flicker.
styles.prompt: neon sign style, glowing pink and cyan tubes, subtle flicker, dark background
styles.html: GLOW

styles.name: Aurora gradient
styles.desc: Large, blurry fields of color drifting slowly into each other. Calm and ambient, and often used behind titles.
styles.prompt: slow-moving aurora mesh gradient, teal, violet and pink, soft blur

styles.name: Grainy gradient
styles.desc: Smooth, shifting color gradients with a layer of fine noise on top. The grain makes digital art feel printed and tactile.
styles.prompt: grainy gradient background, warm colors, subtle film grain texture

styles.name: Duotone
styles.desc: Footage or images mapped to just two colors: one for the shadows and one for the highlights.
styles.prompt: duotone color grade, deep navy shadows and coral highlights

styles.name: Liquid / gooey
styles.desc: Soft shapes that stretch and merge like liquid when they touch, then pull apart again.
styles.prompt: gooey liquid blobs that merge and split, smooth fluid motion

styles.name: Watercolor
styles.desc: Soft, see-through paint with rough edges that bleeds and blooms on textured paper.
styles.prompt: watercolor animation, soft paint blooms bleeding on textured paper, translucent overlapping colors

styles.name: Y2K chrome
styles.desc: Shiny chrome lettering and blobs, sparkles and icy pastel backgrounds, inspired by design around the year 2000.
styles.prompt: Y2K aesthetic, liquid chrome 3D text, sparkles, icy lilac gradient background
styles.html: Y2K

styles.name: Line art
styles.desc: Shapes made only of strokes. The lines often draw themselves on over time, which is called a stroke reveal or line draw.
styles.prompt: minimal black line art that draws itself on, white background

styles.name: Hand-drawn
styles.desc: Wobbly, imperfect lines that jitter a little every few frames, as if each frame were redrawn by hand. That jitter is called a boiling line.
styles.prompt: hand-drawn doodle animation, pencil lines on ruled paper, boiling line jitter, marker fill

styles.name: Pixel art
styles.desc: Chunky square pixels and choppy, frame-by-frame movement, like old video games.
styles.prompt: 8-bit pixel art animation, limited palette, choppy stepped motion

styles.name: Synthwave
styles.desc: A striped sunset sun, purple mountains and a neon grid racing toward the viewer.
styles.prompt: synthwave retrowave scene, striped neon sunset, purple mountains, glowing grid floor scrolling forward

styles.name: VHS / analog
styles.desc: Washed-out color, scanlines, a rolling tracking band and a jittery picture, with on-screen text like an old tape player.
styles.prompt: VHS tape aesthetic, scanlines, tracking noise, chromatic aberration, PLAY timestamp overlay
styles.html: PLAY ▶SP 0:12:07

styles.name: Terminal / code
styles.desc: Monospaced green text typing out line by line with a blinking cursor, like a computer terminal.
styles.prompt: terminal style animation, green monospace text typing line by line, blinking cursor, dark background
styles.html: $ render --style motion> compiling 240 frames> [##########] 100%OK done in 3.2s

styles.name: 1-bit dither
styles.desc: Only two colors. Shading comes from patterns of dots, like old black-and-white computer screens.
styles.prompt: 1-bit dithered animation, black and white only, ordered dither shading, bouncing sphere
styles.html: <canvas class="cv" data-kind="dither" width="160" height="90"></canvas>

styles.name: LED dot matrix
styles.desc: Text built from a grid of glowing dots that scrolls across, like a train station sign.
styles.prompt: LED dot matrix display, scrolling amber text, glowing dots on black
styles.html: <canvas class="cv" data-kind="led" width="320" height="90"></canvas>

styles.name: Risograph
styles.desc: A printed look with dot patterns, overlapping inks and colors that sit slightly out of line with each other.
styles.prompt: risograph print style, pink and blue halftone, slight misregistration, paper grain
styles.html: PRINT

styles.name: Stop motion
styles.desc: Physical-looking objects moved a little between photographed frames. The low frame rate and tiny wobble are the charm.
styles.prompt: stop motion claymation, 12 fps, slight frame jitter, handmade clay character on a wooden table
styles.html: 12 fps

styles.name: Kinetic typography
styles.desc: The words are the main visual. Letters rise, slide or bounce in, often timed to music or a voiceover.
styles.prompt: bold kinetic typography, letters rise in with staggered timing
styles.html: MOVE IT

styles.name: UI motion
styles.desc: App screens come alive: list rows slide in one after another, a cursor clicks and a toggle switches on.
styles.prompt: product UI motion, card list items slide in with stagger, cursor clicks toggle, smooth easing, soft shadows

styles.name: Data motion
styles.desc: Charts that build themselves: bars grow in sequence and a trend line draws across them before the key number appears.
styles.prompt: infographic data animation, bar chart grows in staggered sequence, trend line draws on, highlight the final value
styles.html: +38%
